section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes the development and psychometric validation of the 10-item Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2). The authors report conducting three studies using college and online (Amazon Mechanical Turk) community samples (820 women and 767 men) and provide evidence of unidimensionality, invariance across sex and sample type, and reliability and validity of the BAS-2.
